text:
sam.w: vendor FjordLogistics reports NL customs pulled one pallet (AWB FJ-33021) citing serial mismatch + missing OEM CO. Holding 9 H100s. This will create a capacity gap tomorrow. Ideas?

nina.l: can vendor get OEM CO quickly? if not, provisional bond or loaners?

vendor-fjord: OEM CO turnaround ~48h. We can request provisional release via bonded broker (~€3.2k, 6-8h) or split and send loaners as separate AWB if Redwood signs return PO.

logi-jay: forwarder quotes: bonded broker €3.2k (6-8h); express loaner courier €5.6k (door-to-door ~12h). We have 4 loaners in AMS hot-rack and 3 in LHR that could fill gap.

warehouse-ams: confirm 4 units ready. Need RMA CSV: SERIAL,MODEL,LOAN_AWB,RETURN_AWB,CONDITION. Note: one unit shows recent thermal spikes; ops wants a 15m burn before shipping.

ops-bot: forecast: eu-prod short ~7 H100-equivalents in next 36h. p99 latency +9% if not mitigated. Recommend loaner injection as first line.

sam.w: finance, threshold for provisional bond?

finance-corinne: we can approve up to €3.5k emergency for customs/bond if ops marks critical; vendor offered €1k credit. Anything >€3.5k needs 2-up.

nina.l: ops marked critical. I'm OK signing return PO for loaners. Vendor, can you issue loan AWB within 4h if we send PO?

vendor-fjord: yes. We'll issue LOAN-FJ-901 once we receive signed PO. CI will be marked "Temporary loan - return required" and include refurb trace. ETA pickup ~4-6h.

logi-jay: booking standby with SkyRapid (€5.6k) if vendor pickup slips. If vendor confirms LOAN-FJ-901 in 4h we'll cancel standby.

warehouse-ams: prepping burn and labels. QA checklist: flash image, 15m burn, check idle temps, tag failing >85C. CSV template prepped.

sam.w: action recap: (1) nina send signed return PO now; (2) vendor issue LOAN-FJ-901 + CI with "temporary loan"; (3) warehouse run 15m burn and prepare RMA CSV; (4) finance pre-approve €3.5k for bonded release if needed; (5) logi standby SkyRapid as fallback. I'll follow up in 3h. :thumbsup:
